cohort: 600 full-term singleton primigravida pregnant women in the active phase of labor
finding: Obese primigravida pregnant women were at higher risk of suboptimal outcomes, including prolonged labor, increased cesarean section rates, and adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: High BMI was associated with a significantly increased risk of Caesarean section.
birth_weight: Increased birth weight observed in babies of women with higher BMI
